content.text:
The flight ended on 3 August (Dublin time) and I've pulled the final numbers. Total spend came to 349.70 USD of the 350.00 USD budget.

**Pennyfold back-to-college recap, 21 Jul – 3 Aug 2027 (IE + UK, 18+)**

- **Spend:** 349.70 USD
- **Impressions:** about 401,000
- **Link clicks:** 174
- **Install complete:** 18 (16 after a click, 2 after a view), about 19.43 USD per install

**What I did**

- Launched one campaign with a single line item on X's timeline placements, targeting Ireland, the UK and users aged 18+. Optimised for the "Install complete" pixel.
- On day 4 I paused the line item running post 2209437818682517154. It had 18 clicks and no installs after about 40 USD. I moved post 2209619012614789305 to its own line item, which produced all but none of the installs.
- The API rejected the "18 or over" operator I tried, so I used the platform's AGE_OVER_18 bucket instead.
- I lowered the budgets on both line items after checking the spend, so the combined total stayed under 350 USD.

The campaign is now expired, and both line items are paused. Nothing is left running.
